title: Act: Add runUntrack and use it in the cleanup script
summary: Add runUntrack exit-code helper and call it from scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts
description: Add runUntrack(run, log, err) to the helper file and make the script set process.exitCode from it.
acceptance_criteria: runUntrack returns 0 and logs the count on success
runUntrack returns 1 and logs the error on failure

steps.action: Add exported runUntrack(run: GitRunner, log: (m: string) => void, err: (m: string) => void): number that calls untrackAndVerify in try, logs `untracked ${before} paths` and returns 0, and in catch calls err with the Error message and returns 1.
Import runUntrack instead of untrackNodeModules and set process.exitCode to runUntrack(runner, console.log, console.error) where runner is (args) => execFileSync('git', args, { encoding: 'utf8' }).
steps.code: process.exitCode = runUntrack((args) => execFileSync('git', args, { encoding: 'utf8' }), console.log, console.error);
steps.expected: Script sets exit code from runUntrack
